messages.subject: Error running CMTK streamxform!
parts:
Hi Greg,

i got this error 

Error in cmtk.streamxform(points, reg, direction, transformtype) :
  Error running CMTK streamxform!

when calling

mirror_brain(x, brain = FAFB14 )

where x is a neurolist. However, the example works just fine. 

data(FCWB.demo)
kcs20.flip=mirror_brain(kcs20, FCWB.demo, transform='flip')

Any clues? 

An addition question(s): what's the difference between "warp" and "affine" transform ? Are they based on left-right matching landmarks ? 

best,
arthur
